calling.toggleCallStartConfirmEnable: Are you sure you want to set "{name}" as the call start flow? Incoming calls will begin here.
calling.toggleCallStartConfirmDisable: Are you sure you want to remove "{name}" as the call start flow?
calling.flowLoadFailedDesc: Could not load the flow data. Please try again or go back.
calling.deleteNodeConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this node? All connected edges will also be removed.

callTransfers.title: Call Transfers
callTransfers.microphoneRequired: Microphone access is required to accept calls
callTransfers.selectAgent: Select an agent or transfer to team
callTransfers.errorLoadingTransfers: Failed to load call transfers. Please try again.

outgoingCalls.noPermission: No call permission for this contact
outgoingCalls.permissionSentDesc: The contact needs to accept the call permission on WhatsApp before you can call them. Try again after they accept.

inboxUX.workflowsDescription: Create reusable actions and route enquiries with clear, reviewable rules.
inboxUX.replySafety: Rules can organize work without sending messages. Macros only run when an agent reviews and applies them.
inboxUX.rulesHelp: Rules run in order when their event and all conditions match.
inboxUX.macrosHelp: Macros combine the steps your team repeats. Agents review them from a conversation.
inboxUX.rulesEmptyHelp: Choose an event, narrow its conditions and add actions. New rules start disabled.
inboxUX.macrosEmptyHelp: Add a note, update a case or prepare a reply in one reusable sequence.
inboxUX.noCasesHelp: Start a case in the inbox to try a dry run. Dry runs do not change the case or send a message.
inboxUX.replyControlHelp: This switch controls customer replies from enabled rules. It does not enable disabled rules.
inboxUX.allowRepliesConfirm: Enabled rules may send replies to customers after this switch is turned on. Check each rule's audience, content and consent first.
inboxUX.historyHelp: Applied macros and triggered rules appear here. A dry run does not create an execution record.
inboxUX.ruleEditorHelp: Choose when the rule is considered, who it applies to and what it does.
inboxUX.macroEditorHelp: Build a sequence an agent can review and apply in a conversation.
inboxUX.nameExample: For example, flag an urgent enquiry
inboxUX.orderHelp: Lower numbers run first. Keep related rules in a clear order.
inboxUX.newRulesDisabled: This rule will be saved disabled. Review it with a dry run before enabling it.
inboxUX.conditionsHelp: All selected conditions must match. Leave a condition empty to include any value.
inboxUX.actionsHelp: Actions run from top to bottom. Add at most one customer reply.
inboxUX.deleteHelp: The definition will be removed. Existing execution records are retained.
inboxUX.templateHelp: Only eligible, approved utility templates can be sent. Content, consent and the selected inbox are checked again before dispatch.
inboxUX.noteHelp: Visible to your team. Never sent to the customer.
inboxUX.replyHelp: Service text can only be sent inside this inbox's WhatsApp reply window.
inboxUX.noTags: Create labels in Settings → Tags to use them here.
inboxUX.fieldsDescription: Keep useful customer and case details beside the conversation.
inboxUX.fieldHelp: Use clear labels your agents will recognize. Recorded values are kept when a field is archived.
inboxUX.noFields: Add the details your team needs
inboxUX.noFieldsHelp: Create contact fields for reusable customer details and case fields for a specific enquiry.
inboxUX.fieldKeyHelp: A stable identifier for API requests and filters, such as enquiry_reference.
inboxUX.fieldRequiredHelp: Agents must supply a value before resolving a case. This also applies to automated resolution.
inboxUX.fieldOptionsHelp: Enter one option per line. The saved values use these exact options.
inboxUX.fieldTypeLocked: Scope, key and type are fixed after creation to preserve recorded values.
inboxUX.archiveHelp: Archived fields keep their saved values but cannot receive new entries.
inboxUX.queueDescription: Work through the cases that need your attention.
inboxUX.queueEmptyHelp: Start a case from a conversation, or adjust the filters to see more work.
inboxUX.viewSaveHelp: Save the current filters for yourself or an authorized team.
inboxUX.capacityDescription: Balance active work across the team, for each WhatsApp inbox.
inboxUX.capacityEmptyHelp: Add team members before setting workload limits.
inboxUX.capacityInboxHelp: Choose an inbox to see availability, active cases and each agent's limit.
inboxUX.capacityLimitHelp: Zero means unlimited. Limits apply to the agent and inbox across teams.
inboxUX.slaDescription: See which customer enquiries need a reply or resolution next.
inboxUX.slaEmptyHelp: No matching cases are currently at risk. Include on-track cases or adjust the inbox and team filters.
inboxUX.slaSetupHelp: Choose an inbox, set the targets and decide how working time is counted.
inboxUX.slaPolicyHelp: These are internal response targets. They do not change your customer-facing service commitments.
inboxUX.slaClockHelp: Only resolution pauses while waiting for a customer. Pending and snoozed cases follow the selected clock.
inboxUX.caseToolbarHelp: Update this enquiry's status and priority.
inboxUX.chooseMacroHelp: Choose a macro to review its actions and exact reply before applying it.
inboxUX.targetMinutesHelp: Enter each target in minutes. Targets start when an enquiry enters the human queue.
inboxUX.elapsedHelp: Leave this off to count elapsed time, including evenings and weekends.
inboxUX.agentUnavailable: The selected agent is unavailable to review. Ask a workspace administrator to check this macro.
inboxUX.removeTargetsHelp: Stop applying response targets to this inbox. Conversation and case history will be retained.

inboxQuality.caseLoadError: Could not load this case. Retry to restore its controls and activity.
inboxQuality.settingsLoadError: Could not read inbox settings. Retry to check availability.
inboxQuality.accountLoadError: Could not load the WhatsApp inboxes. Retry to choose an inbox.

sendReason.unavailable: This reply cannot be sent. Review the recipient, inbox and messaging requirements.
sendReason.account_inactive: This WhatsApp inbox is not active.
sendReason.recipient_invalid: The recipient does not have a usable international phone number.
sendReason.service_window_closed: The 24-hour WhatsApp reply window is closed. Choose an approved utility template when eligible.
sendReason.template_unavailable: The selected template is unavailable for this WhatsApp inbox.
sendReason.template_not_approved: This template is not currently an approved utility template.
sendReason.consent_missing: Required recipient consent is missing or the recipient has opted out.
sendReason.template_not_supported: This template requires content that this workflow cannot safely preview.
sendReason.template_parameters_missing: Map every required header and body parameter, then preview this template again.
sendReason.variables_invalid: A message variable or its rendered value is invalid. Review the syntax and message length, then preview again.
sendReason.variables_missing: Some message values are unavailable. Complete the details or author fallback text, then preview again.
sendReason.canned_content_invalid: Check the saved reply: rendered button labels must fit 20 characters, links must be valid and interactive messages must fit 1,024 characters. Edit the saved reply and preview again.
sendReason.calling_unavailable: Business Calling is unavailable for this WhatsApp account. Choose another saved reply or ask an administrator to check the account.
sendReason.flow_unavailable: This WhatsApp Flow is not published for the selected account. Choose another saved reply or ask an administrator to check the Flow.

inboxQuality.completeDetailsHelp: Complete the details needed to resolve this case. Values and resolution are saved together.
inboxQuality.resolutionChanged: The case or its requirements changed, or a value is invalid. Refresh the details and try again. Nothing was partially saved.

statusHelp.pending: Work is still with your team. Response and resolution clocks continue on the configured calendar.
statusHelp.waiting_customer: Use when you need a customer reply. It appears in Follow-ups and pauses only the resolution clock. A customer reply reopens the case.
statusHelp.snoozed: Hide active work until a date you choose. It appears in Follow-ups. Response clocks continue; a customer reply or the snooze deadline reopens the case.

inboxQuality.shortcuts: Outside text fields: Ctrl+Alt+Enter resolves or reopens; Ctrl+Alt+P sets Pending; Ctrl+Alt+W waits for customer; Ctrl+Alt+S opens Snooze; Ctrl+Alt+O opens a case. Ctrl+Alt+M opens macro search.
inboxQuality.conditionsHelp: Inbox, team and other quick filters always apply. Match all or any of these additional conditions. Up to 20 conditions; no nested groups.
inboxQuality.textMatching: Equals is case-sensitive. Contains ignores case and matches literal text; wildcards and regular expressions are not supported.
inboxQuality.snoozeHelp: Choose a duration for this action. There is no global snooze default. A customer reply reopens the case.
inboxQuality.syntheticText: Synthetic incoming text for this dry run
inboxQuality.messageContainsHelp: Matches the text of the triggering inbound WhatsApp message, ignoring case. It does not search message history.
inboxQuality.preflightHelp: This is a read-only prediction. No actions or messages are executed. Applying rechecks the current case, permissions, capacity and messaging eligibility.

preflight.permission_required: You need permission to update this case.
preflight.agent_ineligible: This agent is not an active member of the required organisation or team.
preflight.agent_at_capacity: This agent has reached their active-case limit.
preflight.team_unavailable: This team has no available eligible agent.
preflight.team_at_capacity: All eligible agents are at capacity; the case stays unassigned and routing will retry.
preflight.manual_assignment_required: The case stays unassigned for manual routing.
preflight.team_strategy_will_select_agent: The team routing strategy will choose an eligible agent and reserve capacity atomically.
preflight.required_details_missing: Required case or contact details must be completed before resolution.
preflight.case_resolved: Start a new case before using this action.
preflight.dispatch_revalidates_recipient_and_eligi: Sending rechecks the recipient, messaging window and template at dispatch.
preflight.event_send_already_selected: An earlier rule already selected the one allowed reply for this event.
preflight.send_ineligible: The reply is not eligible for sending.
preflight.team_strategy_selected_agent: The team routing strategy selected an eligible agent.
preflight.needs_reconciliation: The submission is held for reconciliation.
preflight.reconciled: Submission was reconciled with the recorded message.
preflight.actor_unavailable: The responsible user is no longer eligible.
preflight.workflow_access_changed: The responsible user can no longer access this workflow.
preflight.case_changed: The case or its details changed before dispatch.
preflight.case_access_changed: The responsible user can no longer access the case.
preflight.action_rejected: An action was rejected; internal changes were rolled back.

inboxQuality.presetLoadError: Could not load capacity presets. Retry to manage them.
inboxQuality.presetHelp: Preview the limits before applying. Applying copies the preset into the selected team members’ limits for this inbox. Later preset edits do not change existing limits. Zero means Unlimited.
inboxQuality.presetChanged: The preset, team or current limits changed. Preview again before applying.
inboxQuality.historicalHelp: Completed first-reply, next-reply and resolution cycles only. Outstanding work is shown separately in Live targets. Dates use the timezone shown.
inboxQuality.historyEmpty: No completed targets match these dates and filters.
inboxQuality.legacyHelp: Legacy records use the policy known when tracking was upgraded. They do not prove which policy settings applied earlier.
inboxQuality.summaryBreached: No breached cases | {count} breached case | {count} breached cases
inboxQuality.summaryRisk: No at-risk cases | {count} at-risk case | {count} at-risk cases
inboxQuality.summaryOpen: No outstanding cases | {count} outstanding case | {count} outstanding cases
inboxQuality.assignCaseHelp: Assignment applies only to this contact and WhatsApp inbox. Workload excludes this case. Limits are rechecked when you assign.
inboxQuality.assignmentChanged: Assignment could not be saved. The case may have changed or the agent reached capacity. Refresh and retry.
inboxQuality.overrideHelp: A supervisor may override capacity only with a recorded reason. This does not change the configured limit.
inboxQuality.atCapacity: At capacity; a supervisor override and reason are required.
inboxQuality.macroCaseRequired: Start or reopen a case from the conversation header, then return here to review a macro.
inboxQuality.advancedKey: Advanced: edit the generated field key

fieldValidation.text: Text accepts up to 4,096 characters. Clearing the value removes it.
fieldValidation.number: Use a finite number. Zero is a value, not an empty field.
fieldValidation.date: Use a calendar date. Comparisons use the date, without a time of day.
fieldValidation.boolean: Yes and No are both values. Choose the blank option to clear.
fieldValidation.select: Agents choose one of these exact values. Choices cannot be changed after creation.

inboxQuality.policyFutureOnly: Saving creates a new policy version for future cases only. Existing cases retain their assigned version, calendar and targets. Removing a policy also affects future cases only.
inboxQuality.reconciliationHelp: The submission result is uncertain. It is held for reconciliation and will not be blindly retried.
inboxQuality.exportError: The CSV could not be downloaded. Retry, or narrow the applied dates and filters for large reports.
inboxQuality.assignResolved: This case is resolved. Reopen it from the conversation header before assigning an agent.

inboxReview.unappliedFilters: Filters have changed. Apply filters to update the results and enable CSV export.
inboxReview.workloadSummary: No agents in this scope | {count} unique agent in this scope | {count} unique agents in this scope
inboxReview.workloadHelp: An agent can appear in several teams. Their active count is for the whole inbox and repeats on each team row; do not add these rows together. Owners without a team are included.
inboxReview.updatingTargets: Updating response targets for the selected scope…
inboxReview.presetDeleteError: Could not remove this preset. Retry; deployed limits have not changed.
inboxReview.removePresetHelp: This removes the reusable preset. Limits already applied to agents remain unchanged.
inboxReview.choiceDuplicate: Choice on line {line} duplicates an earlier choice.
inboxReview.choiceHelp: Enter one choice per line: 1–100 unique choices, at most 100 characters each. Matching is case-sensitive. Choices cannot be changed after creation.
inboxReview.snoozeHelp: Choose a suggested time, review the exact date/time below in your local timezone, then Save. Working-day suggestions use this case’s response-policy calendar.
inboxReview.selectPage: Select all eligible cases on this page

inboxFollowup.historyReadOnly: This historical view is read-only. Return to the current case to send messages or make changes.
inboxFollowup.olderError: Older activity could not be loaded. Retry to continue from the same place.
inboxFollowup.newActivity: Newer activity is available. Refresh history to load the complete latest sequence.
inboxFollowup.casesError: Cases could not be loaded. Retry or adjust your search.
inboxFollowup.previewReady: Preview ready. Review the recipient and actions before applying.
inboxFollowup.confirmResolveHelp: Confirm that the enquiry is complete. Its messages and case history will remain available.
inboxFollowup.validationError: Review the highlighted details before resolving.
inboxFollowup.invalidValue: Enter a valid value for this field.
inboxFollowup.conflictError: This case or its required details changed. Refresh to review the latest version; your entries will be kept.
inboxFollowup.permissionError: Your permissions no longer allow this action. Refresh to check access, or ask a supervisor for help.
inboxFollowup.caseUnavailable: This case is no longer available. Refresh or return to the inbox.
inboxFollowup.networkError: We could not confirm the result. Retry safely, or refresh to check the current case before continuing.
inboxFollowup.alreadyResolved: This case is already resolved. Close this dialog to view its latest status.

inboxPersonalisation.savedRepliesError: Saved replies could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.
inboxPersonalisation.cannedUnavailable: Personalised saved replies need an active inbox case and a WhatsApp account. Open the current case and try again.
inboxPersonalisation.cannedModeHelp: Use permitted contact and case values. Agents review the exact message and buttons before sending. Turn this off to keep manually entered placeholders.
inboxPersonalisation.flowPreview: Opens the published WhatsApp Flow for this account.
inboxPersonalisation.callPreview: Offers a WhatsApp call for {minutes} minutes.
inboxPersonalisation.renderedLimits: Variables resolve when an agent previews a reply. Final button labels must fit 20 characters; interactive messages must fit 1,024 characters.
inboxPersonalisation.reviewHelp: Check the recipient and exact message. Sending checks the case, permissions and WhatsApp reply window again.
inboxPersonalisation.startCase: Start or reopen a case in this conversation before personalising a reply.
inboxPersonalisation.previewError: The reply could not be previewed. Check your connection and retry; no message was sent by this preview.
inboxPersonalisation.composerHelp: Send opens a preview so you can check the exact reply before confirming.
inboxPersonalisation.uncertain: Check conversation history before retrying. The same operation identifier is kept to prevent a second submission.
inboxPersonalisation.loadError: Variables could not be loaded. Retry before inserting a value.
inboxPersonalisation.noResults: No matching variables. Try a different search.
inboxPersonalisation.help: Personalised replies use the current case's permitted values. Review the rendered message in Preview. Missing values block sending. Turn this off to keep braces as literal text.

reason.empty: This value is empty. Complete it or author fallback text.
reason.archived: This field is archived. Replace it or author fallback text.
reason.unavailable: This variable is unavailable in this case or with your current access.
reason.invalid: The stored value is invalid. Ask an authorised editor to correct it.

inboxRecovery.retryHelp: A permitted retry uses the original operation, exact request and fixed provider idempotency guarantee. It never creates a replacement operation or enables dispatch.
inboxRecovery.cancelHelp: Stop remaining workflow steps without retracting accepted requests, erasing results or resolving an uncertain submission.
inboxRecovery.reasonHelp: Use a single-line summary, up to 1,000 characters. Keep credentials, raw payloads and secret URLs out of this audit record.
inboxRecovery.reasonError: Enter one line, up to 1,000 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
inboxRecovery.previewError: The current review could not be loaded with your access. Retry to check eligibility. No decision was made by this preview.
inboxRecovery.preparationError: A secure decision could not be prepared. Review the current details and try again in a supported browser; no submission was started.
inboxRecovery.originalGuaranteeRequired: This preview does not confirm an original-operation retry. Ask your operator to check the provider contract; no replacement operation is allowed.
inboxRecovery.unavailable: This action is not currently eligible. Check the operation and current access before reviewing again.
inboxRecovery.unresolvedCancel: An earlier provider outcome is unresolved. Stopping remaining steps keeps that uncertainty recorded and still requires investigation.
inboxRecovery.inFlightCancel: A request is currently in flight. It can finish after the workflow stops; inspect its operation result separately.
inboxRecovery.unconfirmedHelp: The server may have accepted this decision. Its exact identifier and payload are kept. Check the recorded decision or resubmit this identical confirmation; do not create a replacement external request.
inboxRecovery.conflict: The confirmation conflicts with current state. Inspect the operation and recovery history, then explicitly request a fresh review if needed.
inboxRecovery.accessChanged: Your current access cannot confirm this decision. That does not prove an earlier attempt was absent. Ask an authorised operator to inspect its identifier.
inboxRecovery.closeBlocked: Resolve or explicitly review the unconfirmed decision before leaving. Closing it would lose the private confirmation needed for an identical retry.
inboxRecovery.recordLookupError: The recovery history could not be read. Your pending decision is kept. Retry the lookup; an absent record on one page is not proof that the write failed.
inboxRecovery.freshReviewHelp: Discarding this local confirmation does not undo a server decision or external operation. First inspect the operation and recovery history. A fresh preview rechecks current eligibility and submits no external request.
inboxRecovery.investigated: I have reviewed the current operation and recovery history.
inboxRecovery.freshReview: Discard local confirmation and review current state

reason.not_retryable_state: The operation is not in a retryable state. Refresh its recorded outcome.
reason.workflow_stopped: This workflow no longer permits the original retry. Inspect its recorded operations; do not create a replacement request.
reason.idempotency_window_unavailable: A sufficient original provider idempotency guarantee is not available. Investigate the original request instead of replaying it.
reason.workflow_context_changed: The execution and workflow context no longer match. Ask an operator to investigate.
reason.case_changed: The case has changed. Inspect current values before any new review.
reason.workflow_changed: The workflow definition changed. This original confirmation cannot authorise changed work.
reason.action_changed: The original action changed. This operation cannot be retried as a different action.
reason.snapshot_unavailable: The original secure request snapshot is unavailable. Ask your operator to restore access; do not reconstruct a replacement request.
reason.input_access_required: Current contact access is required to review the original inputs.
reason.definition_or_values_changed: The approved definition or exact original values changed. This review cannot authorise a replacement request.
reason.not_a_sequenced_workflow: This run does not use an integration sequence.
reason.workflow_already_stopped: Remaining work is already stopped or complete. Recorded provider outcomes remain separate.
reason.message_submission_in_progress: The WhatsApp reply is currently being submitted. Wait for its recorded outcome before stopping this sequence.
reason.reconcile_message_submission_first: Reconcile the unknown WhatsApp submission first. Stopping must not conceal a possibly accepted message.

inboxIntegrationHistory.title: Integration operations
inboxIntegrationHistory.currentHelp: These recorded operation states are separate from the workflow snapshot. Requests, response bodies and credentials are not included.
inboxIntegrationHistory.snapshotHelp: Run snapshot — open Integration operations for the recorded external state.
inboxIntegrationHistory.cancelledHelp: Remaining workflow actions are stopped. An operation already submitted can still finish; stopping does not retract it or prove that it failed.
inboxIntegrationHistory.loadError: Operation states could not be refreshed. Any previous results below may be out of date. Retry before deciding what to do.
inboxIntegrationHistory.noExecutions: No integration operations are recorded for this run. This is not proof that remaining work is complete.
inboxIntegrationHistory.outputsPending: Successful result; output disposition not recorded
inboxIntegrationHistory.manualHelp: An administrator recorded this investigation outcome. It is a manual attestation, not a provider HTTP response.
inboxIntegrationHistory.unresolvedHelp: The external outcome is not yet confirmed. Do not create a replacement request. Investigate the original operation before any eligible retry.
inboxIntegrationHistory.retryHelp: This deadline alone does not permit a retry. Current permissions, original values, workflow state and dispatch holds must also pass a fresh review.
inboxIntegrationHistory.recordsError: Recovery records could not be refreshed. Previously displayed records may be out of date; retry to check the current history.
inboxIntegrationHistory.noDecisions: No recovery decisions are recorded on this page.
inboxIntegrationHistory.evidenceError: The reference could not be read with your current access. Retry to check it; no recovery decision was made.
inboxIntegrationHistory.evidenceRestricted: An investigation reference is retained. An authorised operator can inspect it separately.
inboxIntegrationHistory.outcomeOther: Review the recorded operation and recovery details.

outcome.needs_reconciliation: The submission outcome needs investigation before further action.
outcome.retry_window_expired: The original provider idempotency guarantee has expired. Automatic replay is held.
outcome.output_context_changed: The provider succeeded but the case changed. Review selected outputs separately.
outcome.output_access_changed: Output access changed after submission. Investigate the external result.
outcome.output_invalid: The returned selected values could not be accepted. Investigate the external result.
outcome.manually_confirmed_success: Success was recorded from an administrator's investigation.
outcome.manually_confirmed_no_effect: An administrator recorded that the original operation had no effect. This does not authorise another submission.
outcome.destination_blocked: The approved outbound network policy blocked the destination.
outcome.dns_unavailable: The destination could not be resolved safely.

inboxIntegrations.title: Integrations
inboxIntegrations.description: Connect approved services to a workflow using named inputs and selected field updates.
inboxIntegrations.permission: An administrator with general settings access manages integrations.
inboxIntegrations.loadError: Integrations could not be loaded. Retry to check the current configuration.
inboxIntegrations.saveError: We could not confirm the save. Your draft is kept. Refresh the list to check whether it saved before trying again.
inboxIntegrations.removeError: This integration could not be removed. Disable it instead if a workflow or unresolved operation still uses it.
inboxIntegrations.settingError: We could not confirm the dispatch setting. Refresh to check the current hold.
inboxIntegrations.saved: Integration settings saved. Previously reviewed work checks this revision again before dispatch.
inboxIntegrations.createdDisabled: Integration saved disabled. Review its configuration before enabling it. Workspace and host holds still apply.
inboxIntegrations.hostHeld: Your operator has held dispatch for this instance. Configuration and previews remain available.
inboxIntegrations.holdHelp: This control affects integrations only. It does not enable WhatsApp replies or SMS. An operation already in flight may finish.
inboxIntegrations.enableReview: Allow enabled integration definitions to dispatch queued work? Existing uncertain operations remain held for investigation. This does not enable automatic replies or SMS.
inboxIntegrations.noEndpoints: No approved destinations are registered. Ask your operator to register an exact HTTPS endpoint before creating an integration.
inboxIntegrations.emptyHelp: Define an approved action, then add it to a macro or disabled rule. Previews do not call the service.
inboxIntegrations.connectionHelp: Choose an operator-approved destination. Agents cannot enter URLs or custom headers in workflow actions.
inboxIntegrations.secretHelp: Credentials are encrypted and write-only. They do not appear in previews or history. Changing the destination or authentication may require a replacement credential.
inboxIntegrations.secretStored: A credential is stored. Its value cannot be read here.
inboxIntegrations.inputHelp: Use unique lowercase names with letters, digits and underscores. Each workflow maps a literal or a permitted variable to these inputs.
inboxIntegrations.noInputs: This integration sends an empty object.
inboxIntegrations.inputSchemaError: Each input needs a unique lowercase name using letters, digits and underscores.
inboxIntegrations.outputSchemaError: Use a unique lowercase property name and a different destination field for each output.
inboxIntegrations.outputHelp: Only these top-level response properties can update fields. The whole field batch is validated before it is applied; rich or executable output is not supported.
inboxIntegrations.fieldError: Field definitions could not be loaded. Retry before editing output mappings.
inboxIntegrations.noOutputs: No fields will be changed by this integration.
inboxIntegrations.referenceHelp: Optional top-level string property. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (up to 64 characters). The value is retained as a reference; it changes a field only when explicitly mapped above.
inboxIntegrations.removeReview: Remove this integration definition? Referenced definitions and unresolved operations prevent removal. Recorded operations and recovery history are retained.
inboxIntegrations.catalogueError: Approved integrations could not be loaded. Retry before choosing a definition.
inboxIntegrations.obsoleteTitle: Mappings no longer in this definition
inboxIntegrations.obsoleteHelp: The input schema has changed. Remove obsolete mappings or choose the correct definition. Current mappings are kept until you explicitly remove them.
inboxIntegrations.referenceError: Use a lowercase property name starting with a letter, followed by letters, digits or underscores. Spaces, dots and hyphens are not allowed.
inboxIntegrations.noDefinitions: Ask an administrator to create a definition in the Integrations tab.
inboxIntegrations.definitionDisabled: This definition is disabled. Its intent can be reviewed, but it cannot dispatch.
inboxIntegrations.mappingHelp: Map named inputs using literals or permitted variables. Omit an optional input by leaving it empty. A value supplied by an earlier integration requires another review before use.

valueHelp.text: Text is sent exactly as rendered.
valueHelp.number: Enter a JSON number, such as 0 or 12.5, or a numeric variable.
valueHelp.boolean: Enter true or false, or a yes/no variable.
valueHelp.date: Use YYYY-MM-DD or a date variable.

inboxIntegrations.unavailable: This operation cannot dispatch in its current state.
inboxIntegrations.deferredHelp: The exact request is not yet known. After the earlier result is applied, review the actual values before this step can continue.
inboxIntegrations.deferredReply: This is a partial reply preview. Pending values are shown as an ellipsis. Review the exact message after the earlier integration completes:
inboxIntegrations.reviewUnavailable: This operation needs review. Refresh its current state or ask an administrator for help.

reason.integration_will_execute: The approved integration will run in action order after confirmation.
reason.prior_integration_result_requires_review: An earlier result supplies values for this action. It will pause for a fresh review before dispatch.
reason.integration_disabled: An administrator must enable this integration definition.
reason.dispatch_disabled: Workspace or host integration dispatch is held. Ask an administrator to review the hold.
reason.encryption_unavailable: Secure integration storage is unavailable. Ask your operator to restore the instance key.
reason.inputs_missing: Complete required inputs and any missing variables.
reason.inputs_invalid: Correct input names, types or variable syntax.
reason.endpoint_unavailable: The approved destination is no longer available. Ask an administrator to review this definition.
reason.permission_required: Your current permissions do not allow this integration.
reason.contact_field_permission_required: Updating contact fields requires contact read and write access.
reason.output_fields_unavailable: An output field is missing or archived. Ask an administrator to update the mapping.
reason.integration_unavailable: This integration could not be prepared. Refresh the case and review its configuration.
reason.required_details_from_integration: An earlier integration is expected to provide required details. Resolution checks the applied values again.
